title: Listing Highlight: 100' Ferretti Yachts Custom Line 2012
description: Discover this 2012 Ferretti Yachts Custom Line 100 in La Paz—a 100-foot motor yacht with five cabins, twin MTU engines, and exceptional interior volume.
html:
A Five-Cabin Motor Yacht with Twin MTU Power and 23.75-Foot Beam

The 2012 Ferretti Yachts Custom Line 100 represents a compelling opportunity for discerning buyers seeking a substantial motor yacht from one of Italy's most respected builders. Moored in La Paz, this 100-foot vessel combines the refined design language Ferretti is known for with the practical layout and performance characteristics that define the Custom Line series.

With a generous 23.75-foot beam, the yacht delivers the interior volume and presence that serious cruisers demand, whether planning extended voyages or entertaining guests in style. Ferretti Yachts has long been synonymous with quality construction and thoughtful design, and this Custom Line 100 exemplifies those principles. The five-cabin configuration offers flexibility for owner use, family gatherings, or charter operations, with five heads ensuring guest comfort and convenience. The layout maximizes living spaces while maintaining the sleek exterior profile that characterizes the Custom Line aesthetic.

Every detail reflects the builder's commitment to creating vessels that balance performance with livability. Powered by twin MTU diesel engines producing a combined 5,200 horsepower, the Custom Line 100 delivers the thrust needed for confident cruising and efficient passage-making. With approximately 3,922 hours on the engines, the yacht remains well-maintained and ready for active use. The inboard drive system provides the reliability and fuel efficiency that long-distance cruisers value, while the 3,883-gallon fuel capacity supports extended range.

The 792-gallon water capacity ensures adequate supply for extended periods away from shore facilities. The vessel's fiberglass hull construction provides durability and low maintenance, allowing owners to focus on enjoying their time on the water rather than managing structural concerns. The 2012 build year positions this yacht in the sweet spot for buyers seeking modern systems and design without the premium pricing of newer construction.

Condition reports and full specifications are available to qualified buyers upon request, allowing for thorough evaluation before commitment. Located in La Paz, Mexico, the Custom Line 100 offers immediate access to some of the Pacific's most rewarding cruising grounds. The Sea of Cortez provides exceptional anchorages, wildlife viewing, and cultural experiences, while the yacht's capable systems and spacious accommodations make extended exploration entirely feasible. For buyers considering charter operations, the five-cabin layout and proven Ferretti pedigree present attractive income potential.

Key Specifications:

• Length: 100 feet (30.5 meters) with 23.75-foot beam

• Power: Twin MTU diesel engines, 5,200 hp combined

• Accommodations: Five cabins, five heads, 3,883-gallon fuel capacity

• Construction: Fiberglass hull, 2012 build year Main Characteristics:

• Spacious five-cabin layout ideal for family or charter use

• Twin MTU engines with approximately 3,922 hours for reliable cruising

• Generous 23.75-foot beam maximizes interior volume and stability
